en.hubeali:
From him, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukeyr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Trimming the nails, and taking (plucking) the moustache during every Friday is a safety from the vitiligo and the insanity’.
en.sarwar: 4. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from ibn Faddal from ibn Bukayr who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, Alayhi al-Salam, has said,
’Clipping fingernails and mustache every Friday is immunity from albinism and insanity.’”
